Title: Configure PgBouncer & SQLAlchemy Async Pool
User Story: As a System Architect, I want Postgres connection pooling so that queries execute in <15ms under high concurrent load.
Acceptance Criteria: PgBouncer sidecar configured; 500+ concurrent requests handled without connection starvation errors.

Title: Implement Composite B-Tree & JSONB GIN Database Indexing
User Story: As a Database Admin, I want optimized indexing so that health record lookup latency drops by >70%.
Acceptance Criteria: Composite indexes on (account_id, created_at) and JSONB GIN index created; query latency <10ms.

Title: Redis Read-Through Caching Layer for Catalog & Vitals
User Story: As a Backend Engineer, I want catalog and vitals cached in Redis so that response times remain under 5ms.
Acceptance Criteria: Redis cache TTL set to 15m; cache hit ratio >85%; catalog response time <5ms.

Title: Celery & Redis Worker Cluster for Async AI Loops
User Story: As a System Developer, I want heavy AI calculations offloaded to background Celery workers so API endpoints stay responsive.
Acceptance Criteria: Celery cluster processes adherence loops and blood SOS broadcasts asynchronously with zero main thread blocking.

Title: Integrate OpenTelemetry Tracing & Prometheus Metrics
User Story: As a DevOps Engineer, I want distributed tracing and Prometheus metrics so that system bottlenecks are detected instantly.
Acceptance Criteria: FastAPI instrumented with OpenTelemetry SDK; `/metrics` endpoint exports request rate, error rate, and duration histogram.

Title: Deploy Grafana Dashboards & Sentry Exception Alerts
User Story: As an Ops Lead, I want Grafana dashboards and Sentry real-time error alerts so that downtime causes are diagnosed in <5 minutes.
Acceptance Criteria: Grafana dashboards show API latency p95/p99, DB connection stats, and Sentry triggers Slack alerts on HTTP 5xx spikes.

Title: Vitest & React Testing Library Frontend Unit Test Suite
User Story: As a Frontend Engineer, I want Vitest component tests so that UI regressions are caught before pull requests are merged.
Acceptance Criteria: 100+ component unit tests created for Voice Rx Modal, Catalog Storefront, and Vitals Scanner; code coverage >85%.

Title: Expand Pytest Backend Unit & Mocked Integration Suite
User Story: As a Backend QA Engineer, I want mocked API integration tests for external providers (Tata 1mg, Twilio, ABDM) so CI builds run fast and reliably.
Acceptance Criteria: 80+ Pytest unit tests passing; all external HTTP calls mocked with pytest-mock; 100% deterministic test runs.

Title: Automated E2E Playwright Browser Test Suite
User Story: As a Product Owner, I want automated E2E user flow tests so that login, checkout, and AI voice dictation work end-to-end.
Acceptance Criteria: Headless Playwright test suite covers 5 key user journeys with screenshot artifacts on failure.

Title: Real-Time Tata 1mg Inventory & Catalog Sync
User Story: As a Student, I want live medicine prices and stock levels so that I can buy prescribed drugs at discounted rates.
Acceptance Criteria: Catalog API synchronizes stock availability, pricing in paise, and active chemical ingredients.

Title: 1-Click Order Checkout & Delivery Address Gateway
User Story: As a Student, I want 1-click cart checkout with campus address delivery so that my prescriptions are delivered directly to my hostel.
Acceptance Criteria: Orders created with line items, Care Points discount applied, status tracked from PENDING to DELIVERED.

Title: Create Studentkare Vector Logo Suite & Favicon Assets
User Story: As a Brand Designer, I want high-resolution SVG logos and favicons so that the platform presentation feels premium and consistent.
Acceptance Criteria: Dark/Light vector SVG logos, PNG icons (192x192, 512x512), and favicon bundle added to `public/` directory.

Title: Refactor UI Components to Impilo Pearl Design Tokens
User Story: As a Frontend Developer, I want CSS design tokens for color, typography, and spacing so that UI design is maintainable.
Acceptance Criteria: All component hardcoded colors replaced with CSS variables (`--color-primary`, `--color-accent`, `--bg-card`).

Title: Integrate PostHog Product Analytics SDK & Conversion Funnels
User Story: As a Product Manager, I want user analytics event tracking so that conversion funnels and feature usage can be measured.
Acceptance Criteria: PostHog JS SDK tracking pageviews, voice prescription attempts, and lab package bookings with zero PII leakage.

Title: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) Push Notification Engine
User Story: As a Student, I want real-time push notifications on my phone for medication reminders and order status updates.
Acceptance Criteria: FCM web/mobile push notification triggers sent for daily pill intake, lab slot arrival, and emergency blood alerts.

Title: Firestore Real-time Sync for Chat & Phlebotomist Tracking
User Story: As a Patient, I want live GPS location tracking of the dispatched phlebotomist on a map so I know when they will arrive.
Acceptance Criteria: Firestore realtime database updates phlebotomist latitude/longitude coordinates on the student map view.

Title: Automated Post-Consultation Follow-Up Workflow Engine
User Story: As a Clinician, I want automated 48-hour follow-up messages sent to patients so that recovery is monitored automatically.
Acceptance Criteria: Automated follow-up state machine schedules check-in messages 48h after consultation completion.

Title: Critical Vitals Abnormal Result Escalation Loop
User Story: As a Health Officer, I want high BP or low SpO2 vitals scans to automatically trigger urgent doctor triage alerts.
Acceptance Criteria: Vitals scan with SpO2 < 92% or Systolic > 160 triggers high-priority alert on Clinician Console.

Epic Name: Health Data Aggregator & ABDM FHIR Vault
Title: Multi-Source Wearable & Lab Data Aggregator Pipeline
User Story: As a Student, I want data from Apple Health, Google Health Connect, and uploaded PDF lab reports compiled into one record.
Acceptance Criteria: Aggregator normalizes heart rate, steps, and lab biomarker values into unified JSON format.

Epic Name: Health Data Aggregator & ABDM FHIR Vault
Title: ABDM FHIR R4 Bundle Compiler & Health Vault Linker
User Story: As a Compliance Officer, I want records formatted as ABDM FHIR R4 bundles so that health history is portable nationwide.
Acceptance Criteria: Generates valid FHIR DiagnosticReport, Prescription, and Condition bundles linked to ABHA ID.

Title: Multi-Language Medical Speech-to-Text Scribe (EN / TE / HI)
User Story: As a Doctor, I want to dictate prescriptions orally in English, Telugu, or Hindi so that prescriptions are automatically transcribed.
Acceptance Criteria: Accurately transcribes spoken brand names (Dolo, Pantocid) and outputs structured dosage items.

Title: Voice Acoustics Respiratory Biomarker Analyzer (F0, Jitter, Shimmer)
User Story: As a Clinician, I want voice acoustic markers analyzed from vocal recording so that respiratory wheezing is detected early.
Acceptance Criteria: Calculates F0 pitch frequency, vocal jitter %, shimmer %, and flags acoustic cough wheeze patterns.

Title: Campus Population Health & Outbreak Trend Analytics
User Story: As a Campus Medical Director, I want aggregated health trends so that potential flu or dengue outbreaks are spotted early.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard visualizes symptom frequency by hostel block, fever spikes, and lab result trends.

Title: Predictive Health Risk Scoring Engine
User Story: As a Preventive Care Specialist, I want predictive health risk scores so that high-risk students receive targeted wellness interventions.
Acceptance Criteria: Algorithm combines vitals trends, posture scores, and adherence rate to output risk tier (Low, Moderate, Elevated).

Title: IndexedDB Offline Health Data Cache & Sync
User Story: As a Student, I want my health vault and emergency blood contact numbers stored offline so I can access them without internet.
Acceptance Criteria: IndexedDB stores active prescriptions, vitals, and emergency SOS contacts; works 100% offline.

Title: Service Worker Background Sync for Vitals Submission
User Story: As a Mobile User, I want offline vitals logs synced automatically when internet re-connects so that no data is lost.
Acceptance Criteria: Service Worker queues offline vitals POST requests and flushes queue upon network re-connection.

Title: WebRTC P2P Video Call Setup with TURN/STUN Cluster
User Story: As a Patient, I want high-definition video calls with campus doctors so I can receive remote consultations.
Acceptance Criteria: WebRTC P2P video stream initialized with coturn STUN/TURN fallback; latency < 150ms.

Title: Interactive Doctor-Patient Report Whiteboard
User Story: As a Doctor, I want to annotate X-rays and lab PDFs on an interactive call whiteboard so patients understand their diagnosis.
Acceptance Criteria: Realtime HTML5 canvas sync over WebSocket allows live drawing annotations on lab documents during video calls.

Title: Drools Rules Engine for Itemized Invoice Validation
User Story: As an Insurance Claim Evaluator, I want automated policy rule checks so that pre-authorization approval takes seconds.
Acceptance Criteria: Rules engine parses room rent, pharmacy items, non-medical deductibles, and flags policy mismatches automatically.

Title: ABDM Health Claim Exchange (HCX) Gateway Link
User Story: As a Hospital Admin, I want claims dispatched to insurers via HCX API so cashless approvals are processed instantly.
Acceptance Criteria: Formats FHIR Claim and ClaimResponse resources according to NHA HCX specification.

Title: PostgreSQL Primary-Replica Streaming Replication
User Story: As an Infrastructure Lead, I want database streaming replication so that read queries are offloaded and failover is instant.
Acceptance Criteria: Read replicas handle 100% of analytical read queries; automatic failover with Patroni in < 10s.

Title: Automated WAL Archiving & Multi-Region DR Drill
User Story: As a Compliance Officer, I want continuous WAL backups to S3/GCS so recovery point objective (RPO) is < 1 minute.
Acceptance Criteria: pgBackRest configured for continuous WAL archiving; automated DR recovery test validates RPO < 1m and RTO < 5m.

Title: Tenant Data Isolation & Schema Partitioning Engine
User Story: As an Enterprise Architect, I want strict tenant isolation per university campus so student health records never mix across institutions.
Acceptance Criteria: Row-level security (RLS) and schema-per-tenant isolation enforced in PostgreSQL.

Title: University SAML 2.0 & OAuth2 Single Sign-On (SSO)
User Story: As a Student, I want to log in using my official university email/Shibboleth credentials so I don't need a separate password.
Acceptance Criteria: SAML 2.0 / OpenID Connect integration supports Shibboleth, Google Workspace, and Azure AD SSO login.

Title: Realtime AI Ergonomics Posture Tracker Widget
User Story: As a Student studying long hours, I want webcam posture monitoring so I avoid neck and spinal strain.
Acceptance Criteria: MediaPipe Pose landmark detector tracks spinal alignment in browser; alerts student on slouching.

Title: Sports Injury Prevention & Physio Rehab Workout Builder
User Story: As a Student Athlete, I want physio-approved workout recovery plans so I recover quickly from sports injuries.
Acceptance Criteria: Interactive exercise library builder with 3D joint movement models and reps tracker.
